Karthik —

Quick update for the register: BRIGHTWORKS — AMBER. Usage down ~18% (API calls and session length). Root cause: We rolled out the new token-based throttling on 6/1 to mitigate a noisy tenant; BrightWorks' traffic pattern overlapped with the throttle window and their latency-sensitive routes hit a degradation.

Proposed mitigation (owner: Lauren + Jonas):
- Immediate: exempt BrightWorks from token bucket throttles for their production routes (12–24h) to stabilize latency and show positive signal to the customer.
- Short term: create a per-tenant shaping policy (2d ETA) and move BrightWorks onto it.
- Medium term: run a dedicated canary (dedicated capacity candidate) to avoid noisy neighbor risk (P0 decision for sales/infra).

I'll add these to the CSV and ping Jonas to confirm infra ETA.

On renewal: the buyer mentioned contract terms are getting re-reviewed; CS will need a short exec bridge if we ask for a committed capacity pilot.

-Lauren
